# LibrePhone update, organizing locally, and more in issue 48 of the digital Bulletin — Free Software Foundation — Working together for free software

## LibrePhone update, organizing locally, and more in issue 48 of the digital Bulletin

Our user freedoms are in serious danger. From multiple different [Big
Tech](https://www.fsf.org/blogs/community/2026-ring-offers-mass-surveillance) companies claiming they want to [protect us](https://www.fsf.org/blogs/community/2026-discord-doesnt-deserve-your-unquestioning-trust) while they
steal our rights, to governments working to pass [anti-freedom
laws](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/04/dangers-californias-legislation-censor-3d-printing), our user freedoms are under attack. There are a lot of
concerning and downright scary developments worldwide when it comes to
user freedom, but if we work hard together there is still hope. The
summer 2026 issue of the Free Software Foundation's (FSF) *Free
Software Bulletin* (affectionately shortened to the *Bulletin*),
features articles about work towards freedom. It is impossible to use
a modern mobile phone in complete freedom, but the FSF's
[LibrePhone](https://librephone.fsf.org/) project is addressing this. Many people have spent
countless hours building free video game console emulators, which can
be used in freedom with free games. The hordes of bots attacking the
internet, including many FSF websites, are certainly a nuisance, but
now the FSF has an [Uptime Kuma](https://uptimekuma.org/) instance for communicating when
our sites are lagging. Your computer, even if it is old enough to
legally drive in every country, is capable of way more than machine
learning companies want you to think. Lastly, in the final article of
forty-eighth *Bulletin*, there is a story of how only one person can
start what co...

The summer 2026 issue of the *[Free Software Bulletin](https://magazine.fsf.org/2026-summer)* is now
online! You can read more about all these topics in the articles
below:

- [Ensuring freedom, one blob at a time](https://www.fsf.org/bulletin/2026/summer/ensuring-freedom-one-blob-at-a-time);
- [Video game console emulators: Free or Not?](https://www.fsf.org/bulletin/2026/summer/video-game-console-emulators-free-or-not);
- [Is the site down, is it me? Introducing new FSF Uptime Kuma
Instance](https://www.fsf.org/bulletin/2026/summer/is-the-site-down-or-is-it-me-introducing-new-fsf-uptime-kuma-instance);
- [Your computer is more powerful than you think](https://www.fsf.org/bulletin/2026/summer/your-computer-is-more-powerful-than-you-think); and
- [Free software communities often start small](https://www.fsf.org/bulletin/2026/summer/free-software-communities-often-start-small).

Last month, we sent out the printed forty-eighth edition of the *Free
Software Bulletin* to every FSF [associate member](https://my.fsf.org/join?mtm_campaign=summer26&mtm_source=bulletin) around the
world. If you received the hard-copy magazine in your mailbox, please
let us know by snapping a picture and sharing it on your
[microblogging accounts](https://www.fsf.org/share) using the hashtag #FSFBulletin! We love
hearing about your thoughts on the articles included and where you sat
down to read them. Once you're done reading your copy, share it with
your friends, family, and coworkers, or maybe even leave it at your
local library. This physical way of spreading the free software
message brings us new activists every year from all corners of the
world!

[Commit to freedom](https://www.fsf.org/appeal?mtm_campaign=summer26&mtm_source=bulletin) by becoming an [associate member](https://my.fsf.org/join?mtm_campaign=summer26&mtm_source=bulletin)! Not
only will you receive future copies of the printed *Bulletin*, but you
will also receive many more great [benefits](https://www.fsf.org/associate/benefits?mtm_campaign=summer26&mtm_source=bulletin), all while supporting
our work to protect user freedom for everyone. For as little as $12
USD a month ($6 USD for students) or a [donation](https://my.fsf.org/donate?mtm_campaign=summer26&mtm_source=bulletin), you will
increase our capacity to fight the seemingly endless threats to user
freedom.

We hope you enjoy reading the summer 2026 *Bulletin* as much as we
enjoyed writing it!

*"[Share your commitment](https://static.fsf.org/nosvn/appeal2020/spring/5-share.png)" © 2020, [Free Software Foundation, Inc.](https://www.fsf.org/), by Raghavendra Kamath. This image is licensed under a [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) license.*

#### Document Actions

- **[Share on social networks](https://www.fsf.org/share?u=https://www.fsf.org/blogs/community/2026-digital-bulletin-issue-48&t=LibrePhone update, organizing locally, and more in issue 48 of the digital Bulletin)**
- [News](https://www.fsf.org/static/fsforg/rss/news.xml)
- [Events](https://www.fsf.org/static/fsforg/rss/events.xml)
- [Blogs](https://www.fsf.org/static/fsforg/rss/blogs.xml)
- [Jobs](https://www.fsf.org/static/fsforg/rss/jobs.xml)
- [GNU](http://www.gnu.org/rss/whatsnew.rss)

# LibrePhone 更新、在地組織，以及數位版《Bulletin》第 48 期的更多內容 — 自由軟體基金會 — 共同致力於自由軟體

## LibrePhone 更新、在地組織，以及數位版《Bulletin》第 48 期的更多內容

我們的使用者自由正面臨嚴重危險。從多家不同的 [Big Tech](https://www.fsf.org/blogs/community/2026-ring-offers-mass-surveillance) 公司一邊聲稱想要[保護我們](https://www.fsf.org/blogs/community/2026-discord-doesnt-deserve-your-unquestioning-trust)，一邊竊取我們的權利，到政府設法通過[反自由法案](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/04/dangers-californias-legislation-censor-3d-printing)，我們的使用者自由正在遭受攻擊。談到使用者自由，全球各地都有許多令人憂心、甚至徹底可怕的發展；但如果我們一起努力，仍然有希望。自由軟體基金會（Free Software Foundation, FSF）2026 年夏季號的《Free Software Bulletin》（親切簡稱為《Bulletin》）收錄了關於邁向自由工作的文章。要完全自由地使用現代手機是不可能的，但 FSF 的 [LibrePhone](https://librephone.fsf.org/) 專案正在處理這個問題。許多人投入無數時間，打造自由的電玩主機模擬器；搭配自由遊戲，就能以自由的方式使用。成群的機器人攻擊網際網路，包括許多 FSF 網站，這當然很惱人；但現在 FSF 有了一個 [Uptime Kuma](https://uptimekuma.org/) 執行個體，可以在我們的網站變慢時對外溝通。你的電腦，即使老到在每個國家都已經合法可以開車，能做的事情仍遠比機器學習公司想讓你相信的還多。最後，在第四十八期《Bulletin》的最後一篇文章中，有一則故事，講述一個人如何就能啟動 co...

2026 年夏季號的《[Free Software Bulletin](https://magazine.fsf.org/2026-summer)》現在已經上線！你可以在下列文章中讀到更多關於這些主題的內容：

- [一次處理一個 blob，確保自由](https://www.fsf.org/bulletin/2026/summer/ensuring-freedom-one-blob-at-a-time)；
- [電玩主機模擬器：是否自由？](https://www.fsf.org/bulletin/2026/summer/video-game-console-emulators-free-or-not)；
- [是網站掛了，還是我的問題？介紹全新的 FSF Uptime Kuma 執行個體](https://www.fsf.org/bulletin/2026/summer/is-the-site-down-or-is-it-me-introducing-new-fsf-uptime-kuma-instance)；
- [你的電腦比你想的更強大](https://www.fsf.org/bulletin/2026/summer/your-computer-is-more-powerful-than-you-think)；以及
- [自由軟體社群往往從小地方開始](https://www.fsf.org/bulletin/2026/summer/free-software-communities-often-start-small)。

上個月，我們把印刷版第四十八期 *Free Software Bulletin* 寄給世界各地每一位 FSF [準會員](https://my.fsf.org/join?mtm_campaign=summer26&mtm_source=bulletin)。如果你在信箱裡收到了紙本雜誌，歡迎拍張照片，並在你的[微網誌帳號](https://www.fsf.org/share)上用 #FSFBulletin 這個標籤分享，讓我們知道！我們很喜歡聽到你對本期文章的想法，也想知道你是在哪裡坐下來閱讀它們。讀完手上的這本之後，請把它分享給朋友、家人和同事，或甚至留在你當地的圖書館。這種以實體形式傳播自由軟體理念的方式，每年都會從世界各個角落為我們帶來新的行動者！

透過成為[準會員](https://my.fsf.org/join?mtm_campaign=summer26&mtm_source=bulletin)，[承諾投入自由](https://www.fsf.org/appeal?mtm_campaign=summer26&mtm_source=bulletin)！你不只會收到未來的紙本 *Bulletin*，也會獲得更多很棒的[會員福利](https://www.fsf.org/associate/benefits?mtm_campaign=summer26&mtm_source=bulletin)，同時支持我們為所有人守護使用者自由的工作。只要每月 12 美元起（學生為 6 美元），或透過一次[捐款](https://my.fsf.org/donate?mtm_campaign=summer26&mtm_source=bulletin)，你就能提升我們對抗那些看似永無止境、威脅使用者自由之挑戰的能力。

希望你閱讀 2026 夏季號 *Bulletin* 時，能和我們撰寫它時一樣享受！

*「[分享你的承諾](https://static.fsf.org/nosvn/appeal2020/spring/5-share.png)」© 2020，[Free Software Foundation, Inc.（自由軟體基金會）](https://www.fsf.org/)，Raghavendra Kamath 作。本圖片採用[創用 CC 姓名標示 4.0 國際](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)授權條款。*

#### 文件操作

- **[分享到社群網路](https://www.fsf.org/share?u=https://www.fsf.org/blogs/community/2026-digital-bulletin-issue-48&t=LibrePhone update, organizing locally, and more in issue 48 of the digital Bulletin)**
- [新聞](https://www.fsf.org/static/fsforg/rss/news.xml)
- [活動](https://www.fsf.org/static/fsforg/rss/events.xml)
- [部落格](https://www.fsf.org/static/fsforg/rss/blogs.xml)
- [工作機會](https://www.fsf.org/static/fsforg/rss/jobs.xml)
- [GNU](http://www.gnu.org/rss/whatsnew.rss)
